title: docgraph/v1, a documentation graph
description: A neutral, public contract for a documentation graph (brain.docgraph; packages/brain/docs/docgraph.md): its nodes (decisions, documents and their sections, milestones, criteria, items, changes, tests, threats, modules, owner decisions, findings, needs), their normalised statuses, typed edges named as the Brain names them, a source on every node and every derived edge, declared links with their reason and whether they are confirmed, and the findings of the named checks. Any program may emit it; the Brain reads it read only. Read tolerantly: a key this schema does not name is allowed at every level, so a producer may add one in v1 and a reader ignores it; a key it names keeps its type and its values. A new node type, edge type, status or a change of a named key's meaning is a new id (docgraph/v2). tests/fixtures/formats/docgraph/v1/ holds a document of each side.

generated.description: Who emitted the document, when, and from what.

by.description: The producer and its version, e.g. example-tool 0.1.0.

repo.description: The repository read (owner/name), when it is one.

sources.description: What the producer could read (its files, its tracker...): free keys, for a reader to know what is missing.

checks.description: The findings of the checks the producer ran; a non-empty list of severity error makes the producer exit non-zero.

checks_run.description: The checks the producer ran (a run check with no finding passed).

checks_not_run.description: The named checks its data does not allow it to run.

source.description: Where a node or an edge was read: a file (path, line, anchor) at a commit (ref), or a tracker object (tracker: issue, pull, milestone... and its number or url). A source names a path or a tracker (brain.docgraph checks it).

path.description: A path relative to the repository's root, forward slashes.

anchor.description: The section's anchor in the file, without #.

ref.description: The commit the file was read at.

tracker.description: The tracker object's kind: issue, pull, milestone, release...

id.description: <type>:<native id>, unique within the document; a reader namespaces it by project.

kind.description: The producer's subtype: adr, ddr, record for a decision; tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation, generated, dated-spec for a document; wave, era, phase for a milestone...

status.description: Normalised; the producer's own word goes in native_status.

phase.description: The milestone, wave, era or phase the node belongs to, by its native id.

owner.description: Who answers for it, when declared (a role or a handle, never personal data).

updated.description: When the node last changed (a date or a date-time), for doc.stale.

origin.description: derived: read from a citation (its source says where); declared: stated by someone without a citation, with its reason and whether it is confirmed.

compatibility.description: On a constrains edge (decision -> need): how the decision leaves the need.

id.description: A named check's id (brain docgraph checks), or the producer's own, which a reader shows without interpreting it.

subjects.description: The ids of the nodes the finding is about.
